how: Funbooker lists a 2.5-hour beginner woodworking initiation in Paris 18e covering saws and basic joints, with a level 2 photo-frame follow-up.

Centre Verdier-Photo (Ville de Paris) runs weekly black-and-white film development and darkroom printing courses for beginners and advanced students; Juste un Labo / Inactinique offers intensive darkroom workshops.

Volumes, a public fab lab in Paris 19e, offers 3D printers and other digital fabrication machines open to all; Homemakers (15e) and the Tumo fab lab at the Academie du Climat also provide 3D printing.
Volumes (Paris 19e) and Homemakers (Paris 15e) list laser cutting and engraving among their open-access fab lab machines; the Academie du Climat fab lab also has a laser cutter.
Volumes fab lab in Paris 19e lists CNC milling machines and a precision mill among its open-access equipment.
Go players meet weekly at the Antony go club (Thursday and Saturday evenings) and at Paris-Saclay weekly beginner-friendly sessions; the Paris international go tournament is held yearly.
French Wargame Café in Paris 10e is a bar dedicated to miniature wargaming with decorated tables for Warhammer games and weekend tournaments.
Reset Bar (1er) offers free access to retro arcade cabinets, and La Tete dans les Nuages (2e) is a large arcade room selling tokens from about 2 EUR.
LPO members lead a free guided bird walk in the Bois de Boulogne every Sunday morning (running since 1946), beginners welcome; the Bois de Vincennes has a bird reserve with observation hides.
venue: LPO Ile-de-France, Bois de Boulogne walk

how: Association Atout Chine (Paris 5e) runs a weekly all-levels tai chi workshop, and Paris Anim' centres, the Chinese Cultural Centre and Kordiane (14e) offer adult tai chi classes.
Bridge Club des Buttes-Chaumont (Paris 19e, FFB-affiliated) holds pair tournaments and beginner initiation courses; Paris Universite Club (13e) has a bridge section with initiation classes.

Culture Parkour and other associations hold parkour classes in the covered Centr'Halles Park at Forum des Halles; Pink Parkour runs an adult evening class and the city offers free introductory sessions.
Paris Ice Club (Paris 9e) sells guided Wim Hof-method breathing and ice-bath sessions at 4-10 C, and a cryotherapy cold bath is bookable in Paris 17e.
The SPA shelter in Gennevilliers (RER C) is the nearest to Paris and handles dog and cat adoptions with ID and address documents, plus a Maison des Chats in the Marais.
Espot (Paris 1er) is a 2,000 m2 gaming venue with 120+ PCs, consoles and an arena; Milk Paris, V.Hive and the Maison de l'esport (20e) also host PC play and esports events.
Funbooker lists about seven kintsugi (gold ceramic repair) workshops in Paris, from Amo Studio (5e) to Ceramicafe Genevieve (11e) and L'Espace Japon (10e), open to beginners.
Funbooker lists self-hardening clay sculpture and modelling workshops across Paris (9e, 10e, 11e, 17e), roughly 25-75 EUR per person.
Guided whisky tastings are sold in Paris by Pro Degustation (9e), La Compagnie du mieux boire (11e) and Maison Benjamin Kuentz (7e), with shops such as La Maison du Whisky running tastings.
Polo de Paris, a private members' club at Bagatelle (Bois de Boulogne) and the only polo club in Paris, plays polo; access requires sponsorship and a waiting list.
Rue Drouot in Paris 9e hosts many philatelist dealers' shops serving stamp collectors.
Rowing boats (not pedal boats) can be rented in season on Lac Daumesnil (Bois de Vincennes) and the Lac Inferieur (Bois de Boulogne).
